title: Reinforcement learning for constrained stochastic linear--quadratic control in continuous time
abstract: arXiv:2610.34995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study continuous-time stochastic linear--quadratic control with a scalar state and nonnegative control constraints. With quadratic running costs, randomized exploration can change the optimal mean feedback. We introduce an auxiliary problem without entropy in which the conditional policy mean is nonnegative and the covariance is prescribed in proportion to the squared state. Moment reduction and state separation yield two regional Riccati equations and characterize the finite-horizon value function and optimal conditional mean. We give a sufficient control--cost compatibility condition under which this mean coincides with the optimal feedback of the original constrained problem. For time-invariant coefficients, we characterize the undiscounted infinite-horizon optimum and establish mean square asymptotic stability under the stated assumptions. For unknown dynamics, we develop model-free actor--critic schemes for finite and infinite

translated_title: 连续时间约束随机线性-二次控制的强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有标量状态和非负控制约束的连续时间随机线性-二次控制问题。在二次运行成本下，随机化探索可能会改变最优均值反馈。我们引入了一个不含熵项的辅助问题，其中条件策略均值非负，且协方差按与状态平方成比例的方式规定。通过矩约简和状态分离，我们得到两个区域Riccati方程，并刻画了有限时域的值函数和最优条件均值。我们给出了一个充分的控制-成本相容性条件，在该条件下此均值与原约束问题的最优反馈相一致。对于时不变系数，我们刻画了无折扣的无限时域最优解，并在所述假设下建立了均方渐近稳定性。对于未知动力学，我们为有限和无限时域问题开发了无模型的执行器-评论家（actor-critic）算法方案。
tldr: 该论文针对带非负控制约束的连续时间随机线性-二次控制问题，通过引入无熵辅助问题和区域Riccati方程刻画了最优策略，并提出了适用于有限和无限时域的无模型执行器-评论家强化学习算法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops reinforcement learning for continuous-time stochastic LQ control with nonnegative control constraints, characterizing the optimal policy via an auxiliary entropy-free problem and regional Riccati equations, and proposing model-free actor-critic schemes for both finite and infinite horizons.
